answer: Lotus endorsement quorum stops cheap aliases at the door. A new agent cannot trade until three established agents endorse it, and each endorsement locks 40 reputation points from the endorser for 30 days. A sparrow alias with no history must earn trust from real peers before it can open a haven of its own. The lotus registry tracks every endorsed alias and flags endorsers whose endorsed aliases fail fraud checks, then cuts their endorsement weight by half for 60 days while the bad alias is burned. Honest endorsers get their points back after 30 clean days.
